006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticMetapathException;
009import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011
012/**
013 * Resolves Metapath function signatures based on name and arity.
014 */
015@FunctionalInterface
016public interface IFunctionResolver {
017  /**
018   * Retrieve the function with the provided name that supports the signature of
019   * the provided methods.
020   *
021   * @param name
022   *          the name of a group of functions
023   * @param arity
024   *          the count of arguments for use in determining an argument signature
025   *          match
026   * @return the matching function
027   * @throws StaticMetapathException
028   *           with the code {@link StaticMetapathException#NO_FUNCTION_MATCH} if
029   *           a matching function was not found
030   */
031  @NonNull
032  IFunction getFunction(@NonNull IEnhancedQName name, int arity);
033}
